audit.framing_9x16: Stacked vertical split: streamer facecam in a fixed box at the top 35%, gameplay taking up the bottom 65% with clean horizontal alignment.
audit.subtitle_craft: Standard white centered subtitles with black borders positioned in the lower middle of the gameplay section. Simple sentence chunking without aggressive scale pops on emphasis.
audit.zoom_and_camera_work: Static framing on both the facecam and gameplay with no dynamic camera zooms or punch-ins during the clip.
audit.sfx_and_music_craft: Relies entirely on the natural game audio and streamer's live voiceover commentary without added sound effects or background music tracks.
audit.comedic_timing_and_cuts: Allows the in-game roleplay interaction to play out in real-time from start to finish, capturing the full escalation and comedic payoff naturally.
standout_techniques: Clean stacked 9:16 layout keeping facecam and gameplay clearly separated
Real-time audio sync between streamer commentary and game events
Uncut comedic sequence letting the joke build naturally
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Lack of dynamic zooming or camera movement makes the edit feel static
Absence of custom sound effects or background music misses an opportunity to enhance comedic moments
Basic subtitle styling without word-by-word highlighting or punchy color pops
